title: A Beautiful and Memorable Experience!
text:
What a wonderful experience with Nicole! From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed and at ease. Her beautiful, sun-filled terrace, surrounded by lush plants and gorgeous succulents, created the perfect setting for such an intimate and personal cooking experience.

Nicole was absolutely amazing. She was warm, friendly, and genuinely passionate about sharing her knowledge. We learned so much about Spanish cuisine while preparing delicious tapas with fresh, quality ingredients. The entire experience felt authentic, relaxed, and incredibly enjoyable.

title: Tapas & Sangria Cooking Class
text:
My partner and I took the Authentic Sangria and Tapas Home Cooking Class in Barcelona during the day, and it was an incredible experience!
Our host, Nicole, was amazing—so welcoming, knowledgeable, and full of great energy. The tapas and sangria were absolutely spectacular. We loved working together as a couple to learn the authentic recipes, and we will definitely be making them once we return home.
author: Passenger736239

title: Amazing Experience!
text: We had a cooking class with Nicole while we were on our honeymoon and it was our favorite activity of the entire trip! She had everything prepared when we arrived and the experience was so much fun. It was the perfect length of time to enjoy the food, learn about Spanish culture and recipes and ask questions. We loved that it was a private class so we could take our time and learn from her. We can’t wait to cook the recipes for all our friends and family now that we are home!
author: 978sierras
